usage:
Usage: nscb copy <source> [destination] [--workspace <path>] [--replace] [--json | --jsonl]

Copy one regular file using plan-first validation and atomic publication. When destination is omitted, NSCB uses the configured output_dir or Documents/NSCB_output. An explicit destination is used as provided. The default conflict policy refuses to replace a different existing destination; pass --replace to select the qualified exchange path. Without --workspace, staging uses the host temporary directory. --json emits one job.result document; --jsonl emits ordered job.event records followed by exactly one job.result record.
succeeded_copied: Copy-through succeeded: validated source bytes were published to the destination.
succeeded_already_up_to_date: Copy-through succeeded: the destination already contained the planned source bytes.
cancelled: Copy-through was cancelled before publication. No destination change was made.
cleanup_warning: At least one operation-owned artifact was retained or its cleanup could not be proven.
signal_failure: Signal handling could not be initialized.
internal_failure: Execution ended without an authoritative result.
history_error: The standalone Job history could not be updated. The reported operation result and filesystem evidence remain unchanged; inspect them before retrying.

errors.source_unavailable: The source file is unavailable or is not a regular file.
errors.split_input_unsupported: Copy-through does not accept Split inputs.
errors.source_changed: The source changed after the operation was planned.
errors.stale_plan: The operation plan no longer matches the current filesystem state.
errors.workspace_unavailable: The staging workspace is unavailable or unsafe.
errors.destination_unavailable: The destination or its parent directory is unavailable.
errors.destination_conflict: The destination already exists and replacement was not requested.
errors.destination_changed: The destination changed after the operation was planned.
errors.unsafe_path: A path aliases another operation input or output unsafely.
errors.unsupported_capability: This host filesystem cannot provide the required publication guarantees.
errors.insufficient_storage: The workspace cannot hold the required staging and recovery data.
errors.operation_session_busy: The operation session already owns an active operation.
errors.event_consumer_unavailable: The operation session already has a live event consumer.
errors.operation_session_unavailable: The operation session state could not be accessed.
errors.cancelled: The operation was cancelled before publication.
errors.write_failed: Staging output could not be written or synchronized.
errors.staged_output_invalid: The staged output did not match the planned source bytes.
errors.publication_failed: The validated staging file could not be published atomically.
errors.publication_uncertain: The destination state is uncertain; publication could not be confirmed.
errors.cleanup_incomplete: An operation-owned artifact was retained because safe removal could not be proven.
errors.output_directory_unavailable: The standalone output directory is unavailable or not writable.
errors.output_destination_invalid: The source has no filename that can be used for the default output destination.
